models.name: A1

You can ride this board from 1 foot to 6 foot Hawaiian depending on the size of your board. This is an all around shortboard.

models.name: K3
models.description: The K3 is an exceptional shortboard, designed to deliver everything a surfer desires—speed, control, and seamless flow. Featuring slightly more rocker than our other models, this board excels when ridden in the pocket. Its deep single concave throughout enhances drive, making it ideal for powerful, gouging rail turns. A favorite among both traveling and local pros, the K3 stands out for its impressive speed and precise handling.

models.name: Lemonade+ aka LA+
models.description: A High-Performance Upgrade. We had a lot of people asking for a more performance LA, so of course we created one!! The LA+ has more rocker than the LA. The rocker allows the board to maneuver easier and fit more in the pocket. We also pulled in the outline as well to add more sensitivity. The LA+ still contains a slight single to deep double concave with a Vee at the very end. You can also add a wing to pull the tail in a little bit . The ideal conditions are 1-3 foot , mushy to clean conditions

models.name: Project
models.description: The project was designed to be a versatile user friendly board that is a shorter wider board with high performance characteristics. This design has a fuller outline and the recommended tail design is a round pin but other tail designs works as well. The overall low rocker with a flip in the tail allows the project to paddle well and is very maneuverable. The deep concaves allows for speed and lift over the flats of waves. The Project is the favorite when the waves are knee to overhead.

models.name: Retro Fish
models.description: This is for the cruisers! If you want to get into the waves easier and trim down the line this is for you! It has an overall flatter rocker throughout the whole board. The subtle single-to-deep double concave keeps it fast and responsive, while the deep swallow tail enhances that classic twin-fin feel. The wide point on the outline is moved forward a bit. models.name: SF1
models.description: The SF1 is the first super fish in the Tokoro series and has had great reviews. The outline on the board has a full round nose and the wide point of the outline is up from center. The tail flows into a swallow which allows the board to flow through its turns. The lower rocker in the overall board gives this model tremendous glide and speed. The SF1 is the favorite when the waves are knee to head high.

models.name: SF3
models.description: This model has a fuller outline with the wide point pushed up a little from center. With an even amount of nose and tail rocker the board has great maneuverability. This design also has a deep single concave for added lift and speed. With easy paddling and quick turning, the SF3 is an awesome shortboard machine.

models.name: SFS
models.description: The SFS is one of our most versatile models in the Tokoro performance line up. This model has a bit more area in the nose outline and it has a normal tail width. The wider nose outline assists with paddling, stability and projection. An overall lower rocker gives this board a lot of speed, glide and drive through turns. There is a mild full concave that runs through the entire board with a slightly double in the tail area. The SFS is great in beach and reef breaks from knee high to overhead surf

models.name: SM1+
models.description: SM1+ is one of our high performance shortboards. This model boasts the deepest concave in our lineup, featuring a pronounced single-to-double concave that generates exceptional drive. With a medium nose and tail rocker, plus a deep concave around the fin area, this board delivers incredible responsiveness. The added tail curve enhances release in critical sections, making it a go-to board for progressive surfing in 2-4 foot Hawaiian conditions. Available in squash, round, or swallow tail options
